zone_2_four_engine_body_motion_matrix_1m.core_rule: From 1m00s to 13m00s, NO frame may sit static (`0px` velocity) for > 0.5s, AND FFmpeg integer-truncating `vf_zoompan` is 100% forbidden (`ERR-20261109-01`). Every second of the body is driven by one of 4 continuous 30fps motion engines:

Phase 1 (`0.0-2.5s`): clean shaded topographic/bathymetric terrain + 1 giant geographic anchor (`>=72px`). Phase 3 (`6.0-10.5s`): slow cubic-eased directional maneuver arrow + `map_camera_zoom_match` (`0.55s`, `1.0x -> 2.4x` optical dive) into ground-level 35mm shot. engines.technical_spec: Rendered on Tesla T4 GPU via PyTorch `torch.float32` `F.grid_sample(..., mode='bilinear', align_corners=True)` (`0.000px` sub-pixel smoothness, zero 15Hz jitter) + procedural vector/compositing layers:

six_rigs.RIG_A_PROGRESSIVE_SPOTLIGHT: Smoothly dims 75% of scene to 36% luma over 0.45s while gliding a soft Gaussian spotlight cone + `1.00->1.07x` sub-pixel push onto a physical anomaly or tactical chokepoint with 1-3 word Giant Boxless label.

six_rigs.RIG_E_WEAPON_PHYSICS_CROSS_SECTION: SandRhoman/Jared-Owen 30fps technical schematic rig animating material layers, `15°-75°` stake leverage vectors, tidal drop meters, or ballistic impact penetration alongside macro metallurgy plates.
